style.art: Children's picture-book illustration, hand-drawn 2D style, thick soft dark-brown outlines, flat bright cheerful colors with a light paper texture and gentle watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes. No photo-realism, no 3D render look. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image.
style.object: A single object only, centered, filling most of the frame, on a plain pure white background, no shadow on the ground, nothing else in the picture.
style.scene: Full illustrated scene with a simple uncluttered background, characters large and clearly visible, leaving empty space for speech bubbles to be added later. No text, no speech bubbles, no letters.
style.character_sheet: Full body, standing, facing the viewer, friendly expression, centered on a plain pure white background, no shadow, no props beyond what is described.

lily.name: Lily
lily.desc: a cheerful 7-year-old East Asian girl with a straight black bob haircut and a small red hair clip, wearing a bright yellow hoodie, blue shorts and green rain boots
lily.personality: brave, curious, always says the sound first

max.name: Max
max.desc: a shy 7-year-old East Asian boy with short curly brown hair, a blue cap worn backwards, an orange t-shirt, dark blue pants, white sneakers and a small green backpack
max.personality: careful, loves snacks, great at finding hidden things

pomi.name: Pomi
pomi.desc: a round apple-green garden sprite the size of a melon, with one small sprout leaf on top of its head, big shiny black eyes, rosy pink cheeks, tiny stubby arms and no legs (it hops and floats), softly glowing
pomi.personality: lost its voice when the seeds were hidden, so it cannot speak; it glows when it hears a correct sound and bounces 'pom-pom' when happy

digby.name: Digby
digby.desc: a grumpy old grey mole with a red-and-white striped nightcap, round spectacles, big pink digging paws and a tiny pink nose
digby.personality: hates noise, hid all the seeds, pops out of a dirt hole to say Shh!, secretly lonely, becomes a friend at the end

pose_desc.ref: standing straight, arms relaxed at the sides, friendly smile, looking at the viewer
pose_desc.happy: jumping with both arms raised high, big open-mouth smile
pose_desc.surprised: eyes wide, mouth open in an O, hands up near the face
pose_desc.pointing: pointing to the right with one arm fully extended, looking that way, excited
pose_desc.thinking: one finger on the chin, looking up, puzzled
pose_desc.cheering: both fists raised in victory, laughing
pose_desc.glow: glowing brightly with little sparkles around, eyes closed in delight
pose_desc.sad: drooping leaf, big sad eyes, a single tear
pose_desc.hiding: peeking out from behind something, only half visible, nervous
pose_desc.sleeping: eyes closed, tiny snore bubble, relaxed
pose_desc.shh: one paw pressed to the mouth in a shh gesture, frowning, only the upper body out of a dirt hole
pose_desc.popping: bursting up out of a dirt hole with dirt flying, startled
pose_desc.angry: frowning with crossed arms, cheeks puffed
pose_desc.drum: happily beating a small drum with two sticks, grinning
